screens.focusContract: State heading receives context; recovery preserves or moves focus deliberately.
screens.reducedMotionContract: Static readable state.
screens.mediaFallbackContract: Not applicable unless state describes media failure.
screens.overflowContract: State panel reflows without horizontal overflow.
